studio.aiNotice.title: Generative AI image notice
studio.aiNotice.description: This feature creates images with generative AI (OpenAI). A badge is shown on generated results.
studio.aiNotice.ruleCopyright: Do not create others' copyrighted works, characters, or living people’s faces.
studio.aiNotice.ruleAccuracy: AI outputs can be inaccurate and may differ from your intent.
studio.aiNotice.ruleResponsibility: You are responsible for how you use generated images.
